text:
Diego: Heads-up 10: Integrator partner (CloudArc) asking for clearer SLA on who owns pipeline post-demo. Can we finalize rules before EOW?
Anya: We need a rulebook. Current ambiguity causes double-contact and lost momentum. Suggestion: lead_claim_ttl + claim_action (schedule/demo/hand-off).
Priya: +1. Also add lead_origin tag (marketplace, hw_partner, ae_referral, field_marketing). Different origins need different claim flows.
Ben: For hw_partner leads we should require legal opt-in before any marketing/demo. That's bitten us before. So: hw_flag -> embargo_reason=hw_bundle -> default embargo_days=21.
Diego: Makes sense. For marketplace leads sales ops wants immediate routing to whichever SI has a standing contract in the account. If none, it becomes "open" and marketplace team assigns based on territory_priority.
Anya: Territory conflicts: propose deterministic resolution: highest territory_priority -> owner. If equal, most_recent_winner (timestamp). If still equal, round-robin. Keep it simple.
Priya: On ownership windows: marketplace=48h, web_inbound=72h, ae_introduced=168h. If AE_introduced, AE must complete initial qualification call within 72h or ownership flips to SI for scheduling only.
Ben: We need the flip to be auditable. ops-bot should create an activity log entry when ownership flips and notify both AE and SI slack handles.
ops-bot: Ops-bot: noted. I can emit events: `lead.claimed`, `lead.scheduled`, `lead.ownership_flipped`. Will include metadata: lead_id, previous_owner, new_owner, reason.
Diego: Also add a "no_contact_until" timestamp for accounts tied to joint announcements. Example: embargo_reason=joint_announce -> no_contact_until = announce_date + 14 days.
Anya: Make embargo a first-class enum: [joint_announce, legal_review, hw_bundle]. Each enum maps to default embargo_days but can be overridden.
Priya: Can we also require a minimal handoff payload? CRM id, domain, lead_score, product_vertical, partner_coc_email, best_contact_windows (3 slots). If missing, ops-bot should reject the handoff and DM the sender.
Ben: Rejection message should be terse: `missing_fields: crm_id, domain` and provide link to quick-fill template.
ops-bot: I will validate CSV/JSON handoff payloads. Required fields: crm_id, domain, lead_source, owner (if pre-assigned), lead_score. Validation failure returns row index and missing keys.
Diego: Compensation note: SI should log recommended next steps (scoping call, POC type) but not appear as owner until AE transfers. Otherwise commission tracking breaks. So add `recommended_action` separate from `owner`.
Anya: Good call. Add `owner_role` to indicate AE vs SI vs marketplace_system. Also add `schedule_permission` flag: who can book meetings.
Priya: For global accounts (multi-territory) add `global_account=true` and `fallback_owner_list` with priority order. ops-bot should attempt matching to any owner in fallback list and notify on conflicts.
Ben: Timeline: can ops-bot prototype validation + embargo logic this week? We need the team to trial with CloudArc next Tue.
ops-bot: ETA: 2 business days for validation + basic embargo calc. Will post PR and demo in #partnerships.
Diego: Let's capture this in the Partnerships playbook section: minimal schema + ownership rules + conflict resolution. I'll create the doc and tag CloudArc contact.
Anya: One more nicety: add `partner_visible_notes` vs `internal_notes` so SIs don't see sensitive GTM strategy by default.
Priya: And add `preferred_demo_lead` to the payload (sales or partner) so scheduling is clear.
Ben: Thanks team. If ops-bot can enforce and notify, we should reduce churn. :rocket:
Diego: Agree. I'll roll the doc and a tiny CSV template into the repo and link before EOD.
Anya: thanks all.
